covers: E3 — lens.conkay.uncaught_javascript_error_s_while_walking_the_lens (FIX-conkay-004, medium; fixer muse-b9, §E seating). Fixer build: local branch v1/removechild-genus @ 475c203251 (from f4f1f77ff) — 15 frontend files, one line each: unguarded document.body.removeChild(x) -> x.remove(); plus the pin suite concord-frontend/tests/removechild-cleanup-e3.test.ts. Author of record muse-b7 per CB-0828, named at claim time; content supplied by the fixer (FOR-B7-E3.md), registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's. The capture walk (run 20261117-080754, lens-conkay.json) filed exactly one uncaught page error — "Failed to execute 'removeChild' on 'Node': The node to be removed is not a child of this node." The genus: 15 frontend helpers appended a temporary anchor/textarea to document.body, clicked/selected it, then removed it with document.body.removeChild(x), which throws NotFoundError when the node was detached first (route change, remount, prior cleanup). The fix converts every unguarded site to the no-throw x.remove() form (lib/utils copyToClipboard fallback, components/lens/ShareButton, components/lens/DTUExportButton, + 12 lens/component sites). The two renderer-element sites (ar, sandbox) were already contains()-guarded and the three world cleanups already try/catch — untouched.
